concerns.text: FR-006 requires a mixed‑effects model with a random intercept for dataset (`fidelity ~ method + (1|dataset)`). The plan instead proposes a Fixed‑Effects ANOVA (or Kruskal‑Wallis) and does not include a random effect, violating the functional requirement.

FR-007 specifies a sensitivity analysis sweeping the Silhouette Score optimization threshold over {0.4, 0.5, 0.6}. The plan implements a sweep over Leiden resolutions {0.1,…,1.0}, which does not satisfy the required parameter sweep.
